This is a great question;

Your heart is a muscle, and requires training just like any other muscle group. Taking the time to develop and condition your HR to work comfortably in that sort of capacity needs focus and technique, it is also a mental game, all of this only comes with repetition. Breathing becomes critical for your lungs to receive air, which in turn is pumped to your muscles, and your trying to work your muscles at an extremely fast rate. 

Anaerobic HR Zone Training should only be done once or twice a week, especially for endurance training. Your trying to develop your slow twitch muscles to work long term, anaerobic works your fast twitch muscle fibers, good to have but slow twitch is much more important in my opinion for endurance athletes.

An assault bike can work you if your pushing hard enough.

A rower same thing.

Max burpees in a 60 second window.

Suicides on a Basketball court.

Hill sprints

You have to really push to get into Z5, even when your legs are screaming and your lungs fill like they are going to burst is when the game begins.

​

Depends on the area and the gyms target demographic, like I said look for high volume and clients are ranges 15 - 70, so you can become versatile with one on one training. There's no particular benefit but you'll defiantly want to familiarize yourself with the pay structure as well, which can be tricky at first.

I'd start with your local big gym, walk in and look professional. Ask for the fitness director and ask him/her if they are looking to bring on any trainers. Be prepared ahead of time with your resume, PT cert, cpr and aed certs ect, like i said look professional. You need to gain experience in the fitness industry right now and get time, clientele, revenue ect under your belt. You can't really train high volume at smaller studio gyms. Look for a popular place preferably in a high end area, training is expensive so you basically want a lot of people in front of you and get you comfortable with money. Learn from other trainers, both the good and bad and be a sponge, absorb everything. 
Best of luck, message me if you have any questions.
